messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@carebridge.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Need deeper starter SKU discount for Catalytic pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the cost model looks promising. We are under pressure from procurement to keep initial pilot spend below $35k for the first 6 months. Given our expected token volumes, the current starter SKU pricing puts us above that floor.

Would Redwood consider a temporary structured discount for the Catalytic starter SKU (6 months, then revert)? If you can get to ~22% off list for the first 6 months we can commit to a 12-month extension and expand to dedicated capacity in Q3.

Attached is our internal run-rate worksheet.

Cheers,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Partnerships
Carebridge Health
[Attachment: Carebridge_Pricing_Request_20261106.pdf]

Alex —

Appreciate the transparency and the forward commit signal. I need to run this up to pricing/finance for an exception memo; can you confirm the commitment language you mentioned (12-month extension and exploratory Dedicated conversation in Q3)? If you can supply a short mutual action plan we can include it in the approval packet.

I will follow up internally this morning and share a proposed structure.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Catalytic Starter SKU — exception request for structured reprice

Team —

Summary: Carebridge (prospect) is asking for a time-bound structured discount on the Catalytic starter SKU to keep pilot spend <= $35k for the first 6 months. They are offering a 12-month extension + a commitment to evaluate Dedicated in Q3 as trade-offs. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CB-2026-1187

Proposal (draft):
- 22% off starter SKU unit price for month 0–6; month 7–12 revert to list less 8% (legacy starter pricing).
- One-time onboarding fee of $6k to offset first-run engineering/setup costs.
- Pilot KPIs documented in MAP (attached) and a renewal trigger (usage >= X tokens for +12 months).
- Legal: standard SOW + 30-day notice on scale conversion.

Rationale: This customer is strategically placed in a large HCO network and is a strong reference for our low-latency clinical inference posture. Revenue upside from Dedicated conversion and multi-product expansion justifies a controlled concession.

Ask: Can I get VP/CFO sign-off on the exception as drafted? If yes, I will finalize the memo and send to the customer with the proposed MAP. I attached a working memo (proposed_structured_reprice_memo_v3.docx) and a simplified pricing grid (pricing_grid_catalytic.xlsx).

Attachments: Carebridge_Pricing_Request_20261106.pdf, proposed_structured_reprice_memo_v3.docx, pricing_grid_catalytic.xlsx

Thanks — I kept guardrails conservative but open to edits.

—Naomi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_structured_reprice_memo_v3.docx]
[Attachment: pricing_grid_catalytic.xlsx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Catalytic Starter SKU — exception request for structured reprice

Naomi — good write-up. A few edits from GTM/finance perspective:

1) Make the 6-month discount explicitly contingent on meeting MAP KPIs (uptake and token floor). If they miss KPI in month 4, discount drops to 12% remainder of pilot.
2) Replace flat onboarding fee with a partially refundable credit: $6k refundable against first three months of overage only. This reduces our risk if they underutilize.
3) Require a signed LOI that explicitly commits to a 12-month renewal at the end of pilot conditional on conversion metrics — we should avoid informal promises.

If the customer agrees to (1)-(3) I'm ok to endorse to Ben/Marissa for sign-off. Marking up the memo; Naomi, please include these guardrails in v4.

—Jonas
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Catalytic Starter SKU — exception request for structured reprice

Thanks for the clear packet. I support an exception on a conditional basis with the following required changes before I sign off:

• KPI contingency as Jonas outlined (make the milestones explicit and measurable).
• Change onboarding fee to refundable credit against overage as proposed.
• Insert a 90-day clawback clause if they terminate before the renewal term.
• Add a requirement that any Dedicated conversion triggers a 60-day notice and a tech-handshake runbook to validate KV cache and latency SLOs.

If those edits are included, I will sign the memo and provide CFO-level approval. Please route the final memo to ben@redwood.ai and marissa@redwood.ai (cc: jonas@redwood.ai) for signature workflow.

Marissa Cole
VP Finance (interim CFO review)
Redwood Inference
